lead: The finite receptor-family advice ran and completed 23 ground checks, but it proved neither target within the search cutoff. Ordinary symbolic advice reproduced a checked 19-command incidence proof. All six scientific runs passed conditional owned-resource qualification; the earlier failed run and arithmetic memory failure remain visible.
status_text: Six matched runs recorded: one known proof replicated, two family lanes timed out; no family advantage demonstrated.
